focus_geometry_method: Native IntersectionObserver clipped intersection plus elementFromPoint; fixed portal contents are bounded by their actual containing block, not an unrelated zero-height body box
limitations: Rendered DOM and host-semantic browser controls are audited; pixels inside a remotely rendered third-party page and screen-reader speech require separate human evaluation.

production_bundle.source: Exact production dist frozen before fixture startup; no source transform or concurrent build asset swaps
